Lose yourself in Infinity… but never lose Hope. 
A mind-bending experience.

1947329701.short_description: In Little Kingdom RTS, you take on the role of the ruler of a small kingdom. With limited resources, you must build a base, organize the extraction of wood, stone, and wheat, erect defenses, raise an army, and fend off enemies.

1947375804.short_description: Rampage through the fluffy feltwork arts-and-crafts recreation of the world of Ufouria, with your trusty crew from the original game in this exploration-based action side-scroller. Of course, newcomers to Ufouria are welcome too!

1947427605.short_description:
A cozy, platformer with a horror twist!

This is a short game that can be completed in under 5 minutes. You collect coins and all seems well until you hear a mysterious voice. Things get weirder from there.

This was a short game, created by a hobbyist creator, in my free time, over a weekend.

Note: The buttons don't work on Xbox yet, so you need to quit the game by pressing the Xbox button to bring up the guide, navigating to the game, then pressing the 'menu' button and select 'quit'.

1947447256.short_description: Sodaman is a bullet-heaven roguelike! Fight alien hordes & craft cocktails.

1947449038.short_description:
Rise from the ashes of conflict in 'World War II City Rebirth Tycoon,' where you take the helm as mayor to rebuild a devastated European city. This low-poly city builder challenges you to navigate the intricacies of post-war recovery. Harness strategic planning and resource management to transform ruins into a flourishing metropolis.

Key Features:

- Strategic City Building: Construct residential, commercial, and industrial zones. Revitalize infrastructure and manage the city’s layout to encourage growth and stability.
- Resource Allocation: Make critical decisions on resource distribution to optimize construction, city services, and resident satisfaction.
- Historical Challenges: Face unique post-WWII scenarios that affect your city’s path to recovery, from economic hardships to political upheavals.
- Dynamic Population Management: Ensure your citizens’ needs are met to improve their quality of life and attract more residents.
- Authentic Atmosphere: Dive into a stylized low-poly world that beautifully mimics the - European landscapes of the post-war era, enhanced by a period-inspired soundtrack.

'World War II City Rebirth Tycoon' offers a deep, engaging experience for strategy and simulation enthusiasts alike. Rebuild history, shape the future, and lead your city into a new era of prosperity. Can you turn the tides of devastation into an anthem of revival?

1947538811.short_description: Embark on a unique and unforgettable journey and guide Sable through her Gliding; a rite of passage that will take her across vast deserts and mesmerizing landscapes, capped by the remains of spaceships and ancient wonders.

1947609579.short_description: I can see the signs in my sleep now, always guiding me closer. Will this really work? Have we almost achieved the impossible?

1947615527.short_description: Learn and master various abilities to create your own playstyle.

1947615757.short_description: Become the court blacksmith adventuring in the Sand Kingdom in a fantasy RPG!

1947656141.short_description: Voidwrought is a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. Explore the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation and strike down the gods that dwell there. Grow your powers, uncover ancient artifacts, and expand your shrine amid the wreckage.

1947658323.short_description: Hop into Easter Bunny EggVenture, a charming spot-the-difference puzzle packed with bunnies, baskets, and colorful eggs! Test your eye in fast-paced Challenge Mode or relax in Casual Mode as you uncover clever hidden changes in cheerful spring scenes.

1947684112.short_description: Infinite Adventures is a dungeon crawling RPG inspired by classic dungeon RPGs; with fresh new mechanics for exploration, combat, and progression. You are the Traveler, a hero with a forgotten memory. Assemble your party and explore the Infinite Labyrinth to discover the truths of your past.

1947691593.short_description:
Gold-Miner is a Windows Store and a Windows Phone store game where the goal is to collect all nuggets and diamonds in the level and avoid dynamites.
Enjoy playing.

1947725080.short_description:
Skul is a fast-paced action rogue-lite where losing your head is encouraged. Featuring 90 playable characters each with their own unique abilities and a ton of items that can create wild synergies, the battles are as electrifying as they are challenging.

The Demon King's Castle in Ruins
The human race attacking the Demon King's castle is nothing new and has happened countless times before. What makes this time different though, is that the Adventurers decided to join forces with the Imperial Army and the 'Hero of Caerleon' to lead a full onslaught in hopes of wiping out the Demons once and for all. They attacked the Demon stronghold with overwhelming numbers and succeeded in its total destruction. All of the demons in the castle were taken prisoner except for one lone skeleton named 'Skul'.

Side-Scrolling Platformer Action
'Skul: The Hero Slayer' is an action-platformer that boasts rogue-like features such as everchanging and challenging maps. It will keep you on your toes, as you will never know what to expect.

Tons of skulls, tons of playable characters
Skul is no ordinary skeleton. In addition to his formidable fighting skills, he can gain new and exciting abilities depending on which skull he's wearing. Use up to 2 skulls at a time, each of which has its own unique attack range, speed and power. Choose combos that match your playing style and switch them in the heat of battle to bring your enemies to their knees. The power is in your hands!

The Adventurers
Skul has crossed paths with a party of Adventurers! They are powerful foes that hunt Demons for sport. While Skul may be small, he still packs quite a punch. So just wait and see who really is the hunter and who is the hunted....

Bosses Corrupted by Dark Quartz
At the end of every chapter, go head-to-head with massive bosses corrupted with Dark Quartz and powerful beyond belief. Derived from the pain and hate of life itself, Dark Quartz taints and takes control of everything it touches.

1947752727.short_description:
The third entry in the Monster Hunter Stories RPG series is here!
Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate.

Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series set in the Monster Hunter world, where you can become a Rider, raising and bonding with your favorite monsters.

1947806444.short_description: Goodwill Scrolls is a challenging 2D platformer blending action, precision, and faith. Overcome traps, defeat enemies, and unlock scrolls of encouragement across 15 handcrafted levels. Test your skills in a journey of hope and perseverance!

1947900602.short_description:
EPIC EMOTIONAL DRAMA
Two larger-than-life heroes brought together by the hand of fate, or perhaps something more sinister…

Ichiban Kasuga, an unstoppable underdog who’s no stranger to crawling up from rock bottom, and Kazuma Kiryu, a broken man facing down his last days.

BEST-IN-CLASS RPG ACTION
Experience one-of-a-kind combat with dynamic, fast-paced RPG battles where the battlefield becomes your weapon, and anything goes. 

Adapt your party’s skills to the situation with outlandish jobs and customizations to strategically subdue enemies with over-the-top moves. 

INFINITE ADVENTURE
Live it up in Japan and explore all that Hawaii has to offer in an adventure so big it spans the Pacific.

Unforgettable moments await at every step of the journey with a unique mix of quests and activities to enjoy at your leisure.

1947911457.short_description: VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action is a booze em' up about waifus, technology, and post-dystopia life.

1947937751.short_description:
Born of Bread is a wacky and joyful RPG Adventure, revisiting turn-based combat tropes.
Play as Loaf, a flour-golem discovering this enchanting world full of humor, along with a colorful cast of buddies.

1947938436.short_description: Shotgun Farmers is an online multiplayer shooter where missed shots grow new guns! Fire your bullets into the ground to plant your ammo. The longer it grows the more ammo you will get!

1948002255.short_description: Smash. Collect. Escape. In Cubey: Blockbyte, every jump counts, crush every block beneath you, grab every last coin, and unlock the gate to freedom. Just don’t leave anything behind.

1948090626.short_description: Face the dangers of a futuristic laboratory in Cyber Lab, a 2D platformer with 30 levels of pure precision. Collect the card, avoid deadly traps, and prove your skill with every jump!

1948141872.short_description: Join the race of cute heroes where the cars can transform themselves to real robots and wipe out all the obstacles and opponents on they way to win the race of destiny. Feel the rush, as you tear down the track at breakneck pace in thrilling races. Choose the best hero and car suitable with you ...

1948147176.short_description:
Moving Out is a ridiculous physics-based moving simulator that brings new meaning to "couch co-op"! 

Get ready for an exciting career in furniture! As a certified Furniture Arrangement & Relocation Technician, you’ll take on moving jobs all across the town of Packmore.

1948184622.short_description: Winter Ember is an immersive stealth action game that casts you into the role of Arthur Artorias, the faceless man. Step into the shadows and uncover a mysterious plot that saw your family torn from the history books. On the first night of winter, you unsheath your blade and seek vengeance.

1948201207.short_description:
Do a barrel roll! 

People don't make these kind of games anymore. By playing, we can show them that this genre is still strong!

About the game:
* A - shoot
* Right Trigger - Barrel Roll
* If you collect a missile power-up, it replaces your laser power-ups and vice versa so choose carefully
* With the missile weapon you can hold A for a charge shot, keep holding for a bomb!

Fun facts:
* I made this game over a few weekends
* The voice acting (even the guys) was all done by the same person. Her name is Molly.

Thank you so much for taking the time to play! It means a lot.

1948266948.short_description:
Figure Fight is a fun party game where you can battle it out to the death and solve unique puzzles in over 30 levels.

Figure Fight is fun for all ages with simple yet complex graphics and easy-to-learn controls.
What to fight a giant with your friends. Well you can, what about flying out of a toaster, YOU CAN.

1948342595.short_description: Slide, paint, and outsmart every level!

1948376851.short_description: Play as the enigmatic inventor Nikola Tesla! Use devastating weapons to mow down hordes of nightmarish monsters, collect mighty powerups to boost the carnage, and finally overwhelm your enemies with the immense firepower of the Tesla-Mech battle robot!

1948388283.short_description: Can you change the repeating doomed fate of the world in a fantasy RPG?

Collect coins to rack up sweet bonuses! Use explosive barrels and other environmental hazards to your advantage!

Then you will love this.

1948440918.short_description: Delusion is an unusual puzzle game that tells a story about a beautiful world, full of life and colors, which changed beyond recognition after a series of unexplainable events had taken place.

1948485884.short_description: In Hourglass you can create a time-clone of yourself to solve challenging puzzles. You will play as Aywa, a young adventurer who is traveling to Egypt to find her missing father - an archeologist, who never returned from his latest expedition.

1948624978.short_description: A pyramid-building adventure of historic proportions!

1948697209.short_description: Can't Wait to Die is an exhilarating platform game where every fall triggers a 10-second countdown before you can jump back into action!

1948714522.short_description: In this colorful action roguelite, participate in the festivities organized for the pleasure of the warrior god. Equip your best weapons, prove your valor against powerful monsters, and permanently engrave your name in history!

1948747389.short_description: A cute 2D platformer where a hungry bunny must collect three hidden carrots to unlock the portal and progress through colorful worlds.

1948763092.short_description:
Welcome to Stable Stories - Forest and Meadow Ride, the ultimate child-friendly riding and adventure game that sparks imagination and joy! Dive into a vibrant, cartoony open world where endless fun and exploration await.

Rebuild your dream farm, race against friends, and uncover hidden secrets as you journey through lush forests and peaceful meadows. Collect and care for a variety of horses, and if you're lucky, you might even unlock a magical unicorn to ride!

With seamless gameplay, charming graphics, and a world filled with surprises, Stable Stories is the perfect game for young adventurers and horse lovers alike. Whether you're competing in thrilling races or simply enjoying a relaxing ride through picturesque landscapes, every moment is an adventure.

Saddle up and let your story begin!

1948904222.short_description: Caveman Trials is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer. Play as a young caveman, conquer dangerous prehistoric caves filled with traps, collect 30 golden eggs to prove your worth to your tribe and unlock Xbox Live Achievements!

1948960688.short_description: A puzzle based deck building rogue-like prequel to The Binding of Isaac... made of cardboard. Bum-bo want coin!

1948986948.short_description: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

1949165391.short_description: You’re alone, and no one will save you... this was your choice.

1949242128.short_description: "My name...is Maria," the woman smiles, just like my late wife.

1949370509.short_description: In 1992, following a series of mysterious deaths caused by wild animals, as well as strange sightings of cryptids in the sparsely populated and underdeveloped Amazon region of Acre, a special operations brigade from the Brazilian Military Police was sent to the area to gather intelligence. However, the situation took an unexpected turn for the soldiers, who soon found themselves cornered in the midst of a jungle infested with hungry dinosaurs.

1949420655.short_description: Dive into an incredibly fast-paced and beautifully crafted retro runner!

Fly solo or bring the pulse-pounding frenetic energy of an AVICII concert to your living room with your friends in competitive gameplay.

1949461717.short_description: Back 4 Blood is a thrilling cooperative first-person shooter from the creators of the critically acclaimed Left 4 Dead franchise. Play the Open Beta and experience intense four-player co-op, competitive multiplayer as human or Ridden, and frenetic gameplay that keeps you in the action.

1949492588.short_description: It's winter, 1980. Szymon, a boy raised in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, finds an abandoned Nazi bunker. Will he find what he’s looking for? Play Paradise Lost and explore an underground world, where Slavic mythology mixes with retrofuturistic technology. Discover the last story on Earth.

1949522443.short_description: Delve into an environmental puzzle platformer built on exploring and understanding gravity-shifting structures. You are a voiceless being that has just been born into a world where a bodiless voice awaits your arrival. Go forth and seek your purpose.

Pick your playstyle across match types including 1v1, 2v2, free-for-all and several games such as Xenoswarm, King of the Hill and more. Unlock a slew of cosmetics and attachments for your mech of choice in the Garage.

1949530651.short_description: Construct charming toy towns and cities atop tiny terrain. Combine building blocks to create new megastructures. Test your skills in the physics-based Challenge stages or simply unwind and obliterate everything with an array of cute catastrophes!

1949535961.short_description:
Peepaw's Farm is the ULTIMATE way to experience life as a farmer that hates farming. Get your hands dirty, feed your ungrateful pig, and grab your eggplant - all in a day's work.

BITE-SIZED
Enjoy the 10-minute story when it fits your day.

HARD MODE
Finishing the story is easy - Prove you're a mastermind by completing all of the challenges in ONE playthrough.

1949641254.short_description: TerraTech Legion, a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Build the ultimate battle vehicle block by block and survive waves of robotic foes, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.

1949662682.short_description: The Beast Inside is a unique, gripping twist on thriller and survival horror. Immerse in the story of long-buried secrets, personal tragedies, and madness. Play as two protagonists bounded by dark heritage. Combat the enemies, solve riddles and experience real terror in the 3D-scanned environment.

1949676485.short_description: 16-bit classic comes to the West for the first time.

1949676989.short_description: TANKNAROK is a high speed, frenzied blastathon where 2-4 tanks go head to head in a wide range of arenas; filled to the brim with huge guns, powerful explosions and dangerous hazards! Wholesome roughhousing with either your friends at home, or friendly strangers on the internet!

1949704395.short_description: GREEN HELL is an Open World Survival Simulator set in the unique and uncharted setting of the Amazonian rainforest. Survive on your own, or try your chances in an up-to-4-player online co-op mode.

1949737492.short_description: Mans & Mighties is a free top-down-shooter where you play as a gun who uses humans to fight knives.

1949756621.short_description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ in this physics-based surgery. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

Overcome Stereo Aereo's challenges by avoiding police, escaping prison, battle hordes of space mobsters, and face of the Queen of the space dump, in order to reach your 5 minutes of fame.

1950004384.short_description: Magin is an exciting combination of a narrative-driven adventure game with a deck-building card battler. The branching plot, comic book aesthetic, full voice-over, and game mechanics are tightly intertwined in a unique, dark fantasy world.

1950032989.short_description: ARE YOU READY FOR THE CRAZIEST GAME EVER? Forge your own zany story and explore the world of Athens in this one-of-a-kind, fast-paced, wacky comedy RPG!

1950164627.short_description: Play over 1300 classic retro games, participate in global tournaments, get gold in mini-game challenges, have fun playing couch co-op, and challenge the community to beat your high scores.

1950200874.short_description: Turn off the lights, dodge the ghosts and go to sleep as soon as you can in this hand-crafted 2d platformer!

1950263247.short_description:
Mixtape - Nothing but the hits. 
On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

1950272122.short_description: Hellpoint is an intense action RPG taking place on Irid Novo, a derelict space station soaked in an intoxicating dark sci fi atmosphere. Fight dreadful creatures, face the Cosmic Gods and unravel their twisted story. Should the challenge be too great, play with a friend in local or online coop.

1950365703.short_description:
A girl who never wakes up. She has been fighting monsters in her dreams...
"NeverAwake" is a nightmarish twin-stick shooter with a unique worldview and original game rules.

1950367076.short_description:
New game from the developer of "7th Sector" Sergey Noskov.

There is only you, the abandoned remains of a former life and the flourishing nature that feels great in the absence of man. This world is both gloomy and empty, but so incredibly beautiful.

1950416460.short_description:
Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled journey like no other with Colorful Boi! This captivating platformer boasts 63 levels of intense gameplay, filled with treacherous traps.

Colorful Boi will push your skills to the limit and deliver an unforgettable gaming experience.

Are you ready to conquer all the challenges and become the ultimate platforming champion? Jump into the vibrant world of Colorful Boi now!

With a LEADERBOARD.

1950484406.short_description: Unravel the dark secrets hidden throughout this stirring puzzle platformer about a tormented nobleman confronting the traumas of his past. Use an innovative mirror mechanic to solve challenging puzzle rooms and defeat towering bosses as you strive to piece together the ugly truth.

1950602651.short_description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ solo or play as 4 friends online in this physics-based surgery sim with ludicrous competitive and coop play, plus an awesome builder mode. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

1950684748.short_description:
Experience exciting vehicle action and exploration through a partial area of the Sand Land map in this explosive demo!

In this Action RPG, you will become the main character, Beelzebub. Lead your company of heroic misfits and explore the legendary world of SAND LAND developed by the creator of Dragon Ball & Dr. Slump, Akira Toriyama.

1950703681.short_description:
"I must eliminate them...ALL..."
The bodiless "Hyoki" hunts down the brain-devouring "Slitterheads", lurking in the alleys of a neon-lit city

Set in the densely cluttered streets of "Kowlong," filled with obscurity and chaos, this battle action-adventure game casts players as the "Hyoki," an entity devoid of memory and physical form. His only motive is to eradicate the monstrous beings known as "Slitterheads" crawling around the city, disguising themselves as humans.
Roaming the vibrant neon-lit cityscape, players must seek out allies among humans known as "Rarities," infiltrate and track dangerous organizations, and engage in battles harnessing the power of blood. As the suspenseful drama unfolds, delve into the mystery behind Hyoki's existence and the appearance of the Slitterheads.

1950717553.short_description: In a violent, medieval world, outplay rival gangs in intense PvPvE multiplayer heists. Moving in stealth to steal treasures unseen or dominating through loud and brutal combat, only the best will escape with hard-earned riches.

1950723029.short_description: Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist, and colorful exploration adventure. Flow with Naiad across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. Enjoy a wholesome experience with an original and dreamy visual style.

1950827622.short_description: Catering to solo and multiplayer puzzle fans, Treasure Stack features a wide variety of modes, whether you're testing your skills in Solo Play, partying up with friends in 4-Player Local Party, or taking on the rest of the world in Online Play.

1950881463.short_description: Bum Simulator is a sandbox game bursting with inappropriate humor and memorable characters. You live on the streets of Bumsville. Do you have what it takes to adapt, survive and become an urban legend?

1950909933.short_description: The Last Knight is a 2.5D voxel-based sidescroller blending fast combat, strategic platforming, and dark fantasy. Play as the Last Knight, the final warrior able to reclaim a fallen kingdom. Wield a magical sword, face relentless enemies, dodge deadly traps, and uncover the castle’s secrets. With striking voxel visuals and a classic side-scrolling feel, this epic journey delivers retro-inspired action with modern polish. Will you restore the kingdom or be consumed by its horrors?

1950999790.short_description: In this Roguelite adventure set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

1951040150.short_description: Submerged is a third-person combat-free game in which you explore a mysterious flooded city and discover the beauty of desolation in vast outdoor environments. You take on the role of Miku, a young girl who has brought her wounded brother to the city in their small fishing boat.

1951058598.short_description: Weapon of Choice is a high-energy, side-scroller with unique playable characters each with their own super weapon!

1951062281.short_description: Help the Knight save the castle from dangerous creatures.

1951151775.short_description: The world's best mass llama-slaughter roguelike-lite-ish couch co-op top-down twin-stick shooter!

1951158296.short_description: Journey to the vibrant world of Rune Factory and experience the legendary fantasy farming adventure like never before!

1951168085.short_description: In 1980, you land a teller job at Kertasia Bank thanks to your distant uncle. But the bank follows bizarre rules set by a foolish government. Face strict policies, tough customers, and moral choices while saving for your mom’s medical bills. Your fate is in your hands.
